comment: Bathymetry for lakes GEBCO has no soundings for. Each entry names a lake in
HydroLAKES and a raster covering it; the renderer prefers these over GEBCO.
2. Add an entry below, matching the lake by 'name' (HydroLAKES Lake_name)
file       raster under sources/, in any CRS GDAL can read
depths     true when values are depth below the surface (positive down);
they are converted to bed elevation using the lake's surface
surface_m  surface elevation to convert against; defaults to HydroLAKES'
sign       multiplies the raw values, for grids stored the other way up
crs        override, for files that do not declare one
credit     what to attribute; shown in the build log
